{{Youmay|the creature|the [[Charnoq (Sith Lord)|Sith Lord]]}}
'''Charnoqs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of predatory [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. This kind of reptile lived in the forests and had great climbing and leaping abilities.<ref name="GG" /> The [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]], a primitive people from the same planet, secreted a poisonous slime from their bodies that kept their skin damp and helped fend off most of the carnivorous forests creatures<ref name="NEG" /> — except for the charnoq, which was the only animal on Maridun that the Amanin feared.<ref name="GG" /><ref name="NEG" />
